description: View and modify fibx RPC configuration. Use 'set-rpc' to set a custom RPC URL for a chain (helps avoid rate limits), 'get-rpc' to view the current RPC for a chain, 'reset-rpc' to reset a chain's RPC to default (omit chain to reset all), or 'list' to show all custom RPC settings.

chain.description: Target chain (required for set-rpc and get-rpc)

url.description: RPC URL to set (required for set-rpc)

name: config_action
title: Manage RPC Configuration
